column1: # Qwen3.5-9B W4A16 TP1 lever queue. Columns, tab-separated:
# harness_env = variables the harness names; extra_env = container knobs it does not (verified in-container).
# Tier A - untested speed levers, strict stage gives identity plus a screening rate.
# A4: depth re-sweep. W4A16 is lossless to 6; 4/5/6 were slower at SHORT context only.
# A3: capture sizes matched to the shape a depth-3 decode actually presents (4 rows/seq), rather
# than the 27B lane's [1..64]. Tight list first; an uncaptured shape falls back to eager silently.
# Tier B: determinism reach at high concurrency. Capture must be raised with the rungs or the top
# rungs run eager and confound the identity answer (the x1 campaign's lesson).
